column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# @plural = plural forms: one|other (only 1 is "one" in Finnish).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels, in standard
# Finnish software terminology (Microsoft/Apple fi style): concise labels, lowercase
# Coverage: the whole interface: every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite

# Trailing "…" (U+2026) must be preserved. Placeholders must appear in the translation:
